Correlation between body appreciation an.evidence_source: The correlation values found between BAS scores, FRS indices, and BMI suggest evidence of concurrent validity, revealing their negative association with BMI and positive association with satisfaction (less desire to weigh less), especially for girls. section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section details the adaptation and psychometric validation of the Brazilian version of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) for adolescents aged 10 to 13 years. The study confirmed the original unidimensional factor structure of the BAS in this Brazilian sample, contrasting with some other Brazilian and non-Western samples that found bidimensional models. It also reported a negative association between BAS scores and BMI, suggesting concurrent validity, and discussed the satisfactory internal consistency of the scale. The section concludes by acknowledging limitations and highlighting the need for further research, including the cross-cultural adaptation of the BAS-2 for Brazilian populations.
